rows: Equipment: Bailey Network-90 logic processing and control unit, Italian
Issued to: Esna Power Generation Station

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the logic processing and control unit.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, endorsed by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Aly, General Manager of the station.

rows: A work order must be opened
The unit is out of service and in test mode
Disconnect the supply of the processing unit when changing the power supplies or the fans
Remove the filters from the cabinet doors
Clean the cabinet cards with the blower
Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them
Check all fans, including the power-supply fans, and replace any faulty ones
Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them per the table
Visual inspection of the cards' condition and replacement of any faulty ones
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments

Maintenance Procedure Information System
Maintenance Procedure Information System

Document No.: PCU-001-r0a | Equipment: Bailey Network-90 logic processing and control unit, Italian
Issued to: Esna Power Generation Station
Document status: APPROVED
Document approval date: 29 January 2009 | Procedure: Annual maintenance (I1-Y1)
Next review date: January 2014
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the logic processing and control unit.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, endorsed by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Aly, General Manager of the station.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be opened | 
The unit is out of service and in test mode | 
Disconnect the supply of the processing unit when changing the power supplies or the fans | 
Tools and Equipment
Avometer | 
Blower | 
Work to be Carried Out
 |  |  | Remove the filters from the cabinet doors | 1
 |  |  | Clean the cabinet cards with the blower | 2
 |  |  | Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them | 3
 |  |  | Check all fans, including the power-supply fans, and replace any faulty ones | 4
 |  |  | Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them per the table | 5
 |  |  | Visual inspection of the cards' condition and replacement of any faulty ones | 6
 |  |  | Check the signals in coordination with the various departments | 7
